column3: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column4: to  maintain,  improve  and  manage  the  Madampe

to  perform  and  observe  all  religious  rites  in
Madampe Thaniwella Maha Devale ;
to organize, supervise and carry out the annual alms
giving at the said Devale ;
to  provide  for  the  propagation  of  the  Buddha
dhamma among Buddhists and the fostering of the
order of the Sangha ;
to provide for the teaching of Dhamma to Buddhists
by Bhikkus and for the maintenance and welfare of
such Bhikkus ; and
to encourage the Buddhists to live a life according
to the teachings of Buddha.
